title: Coefficient lift preserves injective etale abelian sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] in universe u, and let I be an injective abelian sheaf [def-sp-injective-resolutions] on its small etale site with values in AddCommGrpCat.{u}. Then the coefficient lift of I by AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u+1,u} is injective among sheaves with coefficients in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}. No affine hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Injectives, Lemma 19.7.3: injectivity criterion on subsheaves of free representables; application in steps 1 and 2 of lem-sc-etale-ulift-injective-resolution.

proof.text: Apply etale_injective_of_small_extensions to reduce injectivity of the lifted sheaf to monomorphisms with objectwise u-small codomain.

For each such monomorphism, etale_ulift_injective_extension descends the extension problem through the fully faithful coefficient-lift functor and extends it using injectivity of I. This supplies the hypothesis of the criterion.

proof_origin.place: Generating-family extension criterion; universe descent made into Lean by N1.

mathlib_searches.query: Universe lift of abelian sheaves preserves homology and injective objects
The universe lift of an injective abelian sheaf on a small site is injective
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.ulift_injective_of_injective is for modules, not sheaves. General Grothendieck-abelian sheaf results do not preserve injective objects across coefficient universes.
No sheaf coefficient-lift theorem. Mathlib group ULift preserves limits and colimits. Exactness reduces to kernel preservation and local surjectivity.

from.place: Steps 1 and 2, injectivity under coefficient lift.

lean.statement: theorem etale_ulift_injective (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [Injective I] : Injective ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj I)
